title: Runs remain within the deciding space bound
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $L$ be a language of binary strings, and let $sp:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$. Suppose $N$ decides $L$ within space bound $sp$, meaning that on every input there is a time bound by which every branch halts, every branch of that length uses at most the prescribed space, and acceptance agrees with membership in $L$. Then for every binary input $x$ and every finite choice word $w$, the configuration reached from the initial configuration on $x$ by running with $w$ has all work-tape heads in $[-sp(|x|),sp(|x|)]$ and blank work-tape cells outside that interval.
hypotheses_covered: Finite-state nondeterministic machine $N$ over binary alphabet
